task_instance: Instrument a browser app with @microsoft/applicationinsights-web (npm install, TypeScript config, ApplicationInsights init with a telemetry initializer, trackPageView/trackEvent/trackException/trackTrace calls), type-check it, bundle it for the browser, and run it in a real browser to confirm the SDK initializes and the tracking API surface executes without runtime errors.
evidence: Installed @microsoft/applicationinsights-web@3.4.4 via npm (npm i --save @microsoft/applicationinsights-web). Wrote src/telemetry.ts implementing the skill's Quick Start (npm) pattern: ApplicationInsights init with enableAutoRouteTracking/enableCorsCorrelation/distributedTracingMode: AI_AND_W3C, addTelemetryInitializer, loadAppInsights(), trackPageView, trackEvent, trackException (with SeverityLevel), trackTrace, and flush(), using a well-formed but fake connection string (no real Azure account/credentials used). Type-checked cleanly: `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json` produced zero errors (tsc.log empty). Bundled for the browser with esbuild (`npx esbuild src/telemetry.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/bundle.js --platform=browser`), producing dist/bundle.js (792.7kb). Served dist/ via `python3 -m http.server 8934` and loaded dist/index.html in headless Chromium via Playwright (installed with `npx playwright install chromium --with-deps`, matched to a pinned playwright@1.56.1 npm devDependency for browser-version compatibility). playwright_test.js captured console output: '[smoke-test] ApplicationInsights initialized: yes' confirming appInsights.config.connectionString was set, and no pageerror (uncaught JS exception) events were emitted while running loadAppInsights()/trackPageView/trackEvent/trackException/trackTrace/flush — i.e. the entire SDK API surface described in the skill executed successfully in a real browser. The only console errors were net::ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED for the outbound telemetry POSTs to the fake ingestion endpoint, which is expected and correct since no real Azure Application Insights resource/connection string was used (per the sandbox's no-credentials/no-paid-service rule) — this does not affect the SDK's client-side instrumentation behavior, which is the skill's core deliverable. Files: src/telemetry.ts, tsconfig.json, dist/bundle.js, dist/index.html, playwright_test.js, tsc.log (empty = success).
